text.autoconfig.imprint.title: Imprint
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.tickInter:
Base number of ticks between footprints.
(player only)
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.speedThre: Minimum movement speed (in blocks/sec) required to spawn footprints.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.footOffse: Distance from the player (in blocks) to spawn footprints.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.footprint: Size of the footprint collision check.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.showWhile: Whether to show footprints while crouching.
Whether to show footprints while crawling.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.rainbowMo: Enables a rainbow effect that cycles through colors with each step.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.showOther: Whether to show footprints for other players.
Whether to show footprints for non-player entities.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.enableDus:
Enable dust/leaf particles when walking on certain blocks. 
(sand, gravel, leaves, etc.)
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.enableWet: Enable wetness effects/particles when walking after being in water.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.maxRender: Maximum distance (in blocks) from the player to spawn footprints.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.removeDis: Remove footprint particles beyond the max distance.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.simplifie: Use 2-corner floating check instead of 4. Faster but less accurate.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.skipColli: Skip checking if the particle is floating when spawned.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.maxPartic:
Maximum number of active footprint particles. 
Set to 0 for no limit.
